description: Deterministically extract facts from a local repo: programming languages, frameworks/libraries, entry points, top-level modules (with role guesses), and a manifest summary. Returns JSON facts only — no interpretation. Use this when you need repo facts WITHOUT a diagram (e.g. to answer questions about the stack). Prefer map_repo for the one-shot diagram flow; use build_import_graph when you need dependency edges rather than an inventory.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the repository root

name: scan_repo
title: Scan repository
